findings.mechanism: N+1 query pattern: each order serialization issues a separate SELECT for line items, causing query count to scale with number of orders, violating efficient data access
findings.remediation: Use eager loading (e.g., selectinload) or a join to fetch all line items for all orders in a single query per request
findings.arithmetic: queries = 1 (orders) + N (line‑item queries) => with 50 orders => 1+50=51 queries
